title: kbingest.py map takes a group's mapper for a language, named as extension point ingest_mappers, and writes its symbols into the map as the shipped mappers do
goal: kbingest.py map reads extensions.ingest_mappers (a language name to a module:attr) and for each such language calls mapper(repo_dir, rev, files) for the files whose suffixes the mapper's SUFFIXES names; it adds the packages, imports, entry points and symbols it returns to the map under that language, in the same record shapes, and a group mapper wins over a shipped one for its language. A mapper that raises or returns another shape adds a note naming the language and the point and maps nothing for it. kbingest.py where then finds a symbol the group mapper gave.

run:
import json,os,subprocess,sys,tempfile,pathlib
d=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); e=d/"ext"; e.mkdir(); repo=d/"repo"; repo.mkdir()
g=lambda *a: subprocess.run(["git","-C",str(repo),*a],check=True,capture_output=True)
g("init","-q"); (repo/"job.foo").write_text("task deploy_ring\n",encoding="utf-8"); g("add","-A"); g("-c","user.name=t","-c","user.email=t@corp.example.com","commit","-qm","x")
(e/"grp_foo.py").write_text("KBEXT_REQUIRES = \">=1.0,<2\"\nSUFFIXES = [\".foo\"]\ndef mapper(repo_dir, rev, files):\n    return {\"symbols\": [{\"name\": \"deploy_ring\", \"kind\": \"task\", \"path\": f, \"line\": 1} for f in files]}\n",encoding="utf-8")
gs=d/"group.json"; gs.write_text(json.dumps({"extensions":{"ingest_mappers":{"foo":"grp_foo:mapper"}},"extension_paths":[str(e)]}),encoding="utf-8")
env=dict(os.environ,KB_GROUP_SETTINGS=str(gs)); out=d/"map.json"
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kbingest.py","map",str(repo),"--out",str(out)],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env)
assert r.returncode==0, r.stderr
doc=json.loads(out.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
assert any(s.get("name")=="deploy_ring" for s in doc["symbols"]), doc["symbols"][:5]
